pages.text: $(l)For Astral Levelling:$()$(li)Use Evorsio with an Exchanging Gadget to rapidly swap Red Matter Blocks with another block type (e.g., via copy/paste profiles) for ~25 XP per block placed/broken.

$(li)Alternatively, use Aevitas with Red Matter Furnaces (highest durability block) and a Morningstar to break them repeatedly.$(li)Alternate between Red Matter Blocks and Red Matter Furnaces to avoid diminishing returns when placing blocks.
$(li)Avoid bedrock: it has negative hardness and yields very low XP.

$(l)For Radiation Levelling (Armara):$()$(li)Combine Thaumcraft healing (Cloud + Heal V) with a spike to self-damage rapidly.$(li)Use high radiation exposure while undying (e.g., Silent Eternity or Charm of Life II) for safe, rapid leveling.$(li)Radiation can reach level 30 in under 2 minutes from level 0;
at high levels you gain so much per hit that you hit the per-hit cap even at level 100.

$(l)Automation & Notes:$()$(li)Automate Evorsio leveling with conveyor belts moving blocks into a breaker (e.g., unbreakable wand) and AFK.$(li)Collector crystals from Astral Shrines can be stolen with a Sack of Holding—but may cause bugs.
$(li)Kikoku’s HP drain effect does not work as commonly believed; not recommended for boss fights.$(li)The Last Stand perk is often unusable due to high saturation and max health in this pack.
